name: Levi (son of Leah)
title: Ancestor of the priestly tribe
summary: Levi was the third son of Jacob and Leah, and the ancestor of the Levites who later became Israel's priestly tribe. He is known for his violent revenge against Shechem together with his brother Simeon, which led Jacob to condemn their anger. Despite this, his descendants were chosen to serve God in the tabernacle and temple.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Levi
keyEvents.description: Levi was born as Jacob's third son with Leah. His name means 'attached,' because Leah hoped that Jacob would now be attached to her.

keyEvents.title: The Revenge on Shechem
keyEvents.description: After Shechem had violated their sister Dinah, Levi and Simeon took bloody revenge by killing all the men in the city while they were weakened after circumcision.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Levi traveled with his father Jacob and the entire family to Egypt during the famine, where they were reunited with Joseph.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Prophetic Words
keyEvents.description: On his deathbed, Jacob condemned the fierce anger of Levi and Simeon and prophesied that they would be scattered in Israel, which was fulfilled when the Levites did not receive their own territory.

keyEvents.title: Levi's Death and Lifespan
keyEvents.description: Levi lived 137 years and died in Egypt. His descendants, especially through his son Kohath, included Moses and Aaron.
